about.text:
PanePilot {version}

Two-panel file manager modelled on FreeCommander.

Settings and favorites are stored in:
{config}

Built with Python and Qt (PySide6).
action.extract_subfolder_many: Extract each into its own folder
dialog.compress_what: Pack {what}. The archive is created in the folder {folder}.
archive.link_dir_skipped: Link to a folder – not possible in a ZIP archive, skipped
archive.outside_target: Entry would end up outside the target folder – not extracted
archive.damaged: Archive is damaged or not a valid archive ({reason})
archive.tool_failed: The archiver stopped with error code {code}
toolbar.title: Toolbar
filter.invert: Hide matches instead of showing them
filter.hint_wildcard: * = any characters, ? = one character, separate several patterns with ; (e.g. *.pdf;*.docx). Without wildcards, part of the name is enough. With “Hide folders” the pattern may stay empty.
favsets.delete_confirm: Delete favorites set “{name}” with {n} entries (top level)?
favsets.error_chars: “{name}” contains characters that are not allowed in file names (e.g. / \ : * ? " < > |) or starts with a dot.
favorites.no_sidebar: No favorites sidebar is open in the active panel. Please first open the favorites sidebar in the desired panel (Alt+F) and choose the favorites set.
fkeys.gnome_reserved: Used by GNOME – not usable from the keyboard, but works with a mouse click while holding Alt.
rename.title: Multi-rename
rename.profile_overwrite: A profile “{name}” already exists. Overwrite it?
rename.date_hint: JJJJ/JJ = year, MM = month, TT = day, hh = hour, mm = minute, ss = second
rename.summary_conflicts: {n} conflict(s) – please check the lines marked in red.
rename.err_empty: The new name is empty or invalid.
rename.err_chars: The new name contains a forbidden character (/).
rename.err_exists_now: Target name is now taken – not renamed
rename.errors_intro: The following items could not be renamed:
colprof.name_prompt: Name of the column profile (takes over the current columns of this panel):
settings.title: Settings
settings.lang_restart_hint: A new language takes effect after restarting PanePilot. ✎ = your own language file.
settings.prof_hint: Set the order and width of the columns directly in the panel (drag the column header) – the active profile remembers it automatically.
settings.backup_hint: A backup is made automatically at the first start of each day. Backups made by hand are never deleted.
settings.lang_changed: The new language takes effect after a restart. Restart now?
backup.unreachable: Backup not possible: {folder} is not reachable (share not mounted?).
backup.done:
The settings have been backed up:
{path}
backup.restore_confirm: Restore the settings from “{name}”? The current state is backed up first, then PanePilot restarts.
lang.name: Display name:
lang.new_hint: The new language starts with empty texts. Anything you do not translate appears in the fallback language.
lang.err_exists: A language with the code “{code}” already exists.
lang.tip_missing: Missing – the fallback language is shown.
lang.tip_placeholder: The placeholders in {curly braces} must be the same as in the template.
lang.edit_hint: Saved as your own language file in the settings folder (Sprachen/). Changes take effect after a restart.

props.meta_coming: The metadata editor follows in version 0.9.

search.title: Search
search.text_hint: Only text files are searched (no images, programs, Office or PDF files).
search.err_empty: Please enter a file name or a text.
search.skipped: {n} large file(s) over 100 MB were skipped in the text search (hover here for the list).
checksum.title: Checksums
checksum.no_file: Please select a file (folders have no checksum).
checksum.unknown_format: Not a known checksum format (expected: 8, 32, 40, 64 or 128 hex characters).
search.network_hint: Network shares can slow the search down considerably.
backup.import_failed: The file is not a valid PanePilot backup or could not be copied: {reason}
meta.title: Meta Wizard
meta.field.title: Title
meta.read_errors: {n} file(s) could not be read (marked red).
meta.loaded: {n} files read. Select tracks to edit them.
meta.save_errors: The following files could not be saved (the changes remain marked):
meta.unsaved: {n} file(s) have unsaved changes. Save now?
meta.wav_hint: Note: many players ignore tags in WAV files.
meta.cover_hint: Right-click the picture to replace, remove or save the cover. You can also drag a picture here.
conv.no_match: The file name does not match the pattern.
conv.marked: {n} track(s) marked red and not changed (reason: hover over the row).
fields.title: Edit tag fields
fields.intro: Here you only change the structure of the tags of all {n} tracks in the list: delete, rename or add fields. Edit the contents in the sidebar.
fields.delete_tip: Delete the field and its contents from all files
fields.hint: New fields stay empty until you enter a value in the sidebar – only then are they written to the files. Changes are written with “Save tags”.
fields.tip_standard: Standard field – cannot be deleted or renamed.
fields.tip_known: Known field with a fixed name – can be deleted but not renamed.
fields.tip_fixed: Field with a fixed name – can only be deleted.
fields.tip_data: Data field without readable contents – can only be deleted.
fields.err_name: “{name}” is not a valid field name. Letters, digits, spaces, “_” and “-” are allowed.
fields.err_known: “{name}” is the name of a known field. Use “Tag → tag” to move contents.
textimp.hint: Files on the left, lines on the right – entries side by side belong together. Move them with “Move up”/“Move down”, fill gaps with “Insert placeholder”. Empty cells leave a field unchanged, “<remove>” deletes it.
textimp.preview_skip: There is a placeholder opposite – nothing is taken over here.
textimp.done: {n} track(s) taken from the text file.
number.title: Numbering wizard
number.intro: Track numbers for {n} tracks are assigned top to bottom in the order of the list.
playlist.title: Create playlist
playlist.intro: Create a playlist with {n} tracks under this name:
playlist.hint_relative: Tracks are listed relative to the playlist's location – it also works if the NAS is mounted elsewhere (e.g. on Windows).
playlist.hint_absolute: Tracks are listed with their full Linux path – the playlist will not work on Windows.
checksum.file_no_entry: “{name}” contains no checksum for the selected file.
toolbar.spacer_width: Width of the gap (also changes the selected gap)
rg.needs_ffmpeg: Requires the “ffmpeg” package (sudo apt install ffmpeg).
rg.intro: The loudness of {n} tracks will be measured ({albums} albums by album tag). Target loudness: {target} LUFS (can be changed in the settings). The music itself is not changed – only tags are written.
rg.hint: Without the check mark only missing values are added. For the album value all tracks with the same album tag are measured. Measuring takes about 1–3 seconds per track.
rg.done: ReplayGain: {n} tracks measured, {changed} with new values (green) – write them with “Save tags”.
rg.nothing: All tracks already have ReplayGain values. Tick “Overwrite existing values” to recalculate.
rg.errors: The following files could not be measured:
settings.rg_hint: −18 LUFS is the ReplayGain standard. Other values do not match what foobar2000 and most players expect.
settings.display_hint: These switches are also in the “View” menu. They take effect after “OK”.

lang.import_failed: The file is not a usable language file ({reason}).

“{name}” is a bundled language. The texts from the file are taken over as your changes; texts equal to the original stay with the original. Your previous changes to “{name}” are replaced.

Continue?
lang.import_confirm_own: There is already an own language “{name}” ({code}). Replace it with the file?
lang.import_done: {n} texts taken over for “{name}”. The changes apply after a restart.
lang.import_bad: {n} texts with wrong placeholders were not taken over: {keys}
lang.import_unknown: {n} unknown texts were ignored (e.g. from another PanePilot version).
lang.reset_confirm:
Delete all your changes to “{name}” and use the bundled texts again?
This applies after a restart.
lang.edit_hint_bundled: Change whatever you don’t like in the “Your text” column. Changed texts have a blue background and are saved as your own file in the settings folder (Sprachen/); all others stay with the original. If you empty a field, the original applies again. The changes apply after a restart.
donate.title: Support PanePilot
donate.text:
PanePilot is free of charge and free software.

If you like PanePilot and want to support its development, I'd be happy about a coffee via Ko-fi.

As a thank-you you get a personal supporter code, and this note no longer appears.
donate.code_hint: Enter your name exactly as it belongs to your code (upper/lower case does not matter) and paste the code.
donate.code_wrong: Name and code do not match. Please check the spelling of the name and whether the code was pasted completely.
donate.thanks: Thank you very much for your support, {name}! The note will no longer appear.
